storyIntroAbout: EAZY-IRA Charity Foundation grew from young volunteers' commitment to children and community.
aboutStoryFirst: In {month} {year}, {founders} university student volunteers started a weekly children's gathering in Masoro, Kigali. They shared a meal and taught moral values, positive attitudes, and politeness.
aboutStorySecond: The gathering grew into a wider child-development effort, rooted in the community and focused on education, nutrition, spiritual and moral development, mentorship, and community support. Today, EAZY-IRA Charity Foundation continues that work through fellowship, education support, and outreach to families.
